requirement: The data warehousing system shall permit modification of fact and dimension tables only by ETL jobs and administrators holding explicit write privileges.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must restrict edits to salary and bank-account records to staff members whose role grants payroll update rights.
The web browser shall prevent web pages and unapproved extensions from altering saved bookmarks and stored browser settings.
The online banking application shall verify the digital signature of each payment instruction against the account holder's registered key before executing it.
The sales forecasting system must verify the claimed origin of every uploaded sales data feed using the submitting source's registered certificate before the feed is accepted.
The compiler shall require a developer to be identified by a face-biometric match before it signs a release build.
The smart-home IoT controller must identify residents by matching their face against enrolled templates before unlocking the front door.
The hospital patient-record system shall reject any update that would leave a patient's medication, allergy and diagnosis entries mutually inconsistent.
The smart-card electronic purse must detect and refuse any attempt to alter the stored balance outside a completed and validated load or debit operation.
The online banking application shall guarantee that the debit and credit legs of a transfer are recorded with identical amounts, and shall reject any entry that breaks that match.
The simulation software shall accept a single institutional login from a researcher for access to the model library, the job scheduler and the results portal, without asking for credentials again.
The online banking application must let a customer who has proven their identity once reach the savings, cards and loans modules without a further login prompt during the same session.
The simulation software shall compute a cryptographic digest of each input scenario file on import so that later changes to the file can be detected.
The smart-card electronic purse must calculate a hash over every transaction record it stores, enabling the terminal to detect tampering with that record.
The compiler shall produce a checksum for each generated object file so that any alteration of the file after compilation can be detected at link time.
The smart-card electronic purse shall attach a hash value to its stored balance and must refuse to operate when the recomputed value differs from the stored one.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must compare a stored hash of each approved payslip batch with a recomputed hash before release, and block payment on any mismatch.
The hospital patient-record system shall store a digest with every discharge summary and flag the record as corrupted when a later digest comparison fails.
The screen capture tool shall check the secret entered by a user against the stored credential before granting access to saved recordings.
The simulation software must confirm that the secret supplied at login matches the one registered for the account before opening a workspace.
The web browser must require the profile owner to be verified before it allows edits to synchronised passwords and autofill entries.
The sales forecasting system shall let only the analyst who owns a forecast scenario change its assumptions and adjusted figures.
The online booking system shall allow only the customer who made a reservation, or an authorised agent, to amend or cancel it.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system shall issue a one-time code from the server that expires after a configured number of seconds and is required to complete an employee's login.
The simulation software must have its server create a time-limited one-time code for each researcher sign-in and reject that code once its validity period has elapsed.
The smart-home IoT controller shall verify the identity of every person and companion app before accepting any command.
The air traffic control software must establish the identity of each controller and each connected radar feed before granting it access to flight data.
The web browser shall ask a user to confirm their identity again by answering personal challenge questions before revealing saved payment cards.
The hospital patient-record system must re-confirm a clinician's identity with additional challenge questions before opening a record flagged as restricted.
